name: Staleness
responsibility: Says which code the running server runs: whether it loaded the source on disk now, which frontend build is on disk, and whether a tab's bundle is older
description: A checkout's server runs TypeScript that it loaded once, so it compares the time of every source file it loaded with the time of loading, and compares the entry script of the bundle a tab fetched with the bundle on disk. It reads the root and the frontend directory from the installation. serverCodeState answers /health with the source state and the frontend build; a tab's question goes to staleFrontend, which stats no source file. status says when either is stale.

outgoing.label: the root to compare, and the frontend directory
